shipment_events.description: 1,014.881 MT of aluminum ingot fully received into storage in two batches; the Nanhai, Foshan designated warehouse issued electronic warehouse receipt EWR-2026-FS-AL0-00014.
Buyer and seller completed spot cash settlement (T/T in installments); the warehouse receipt ownership transfer process has started.
SouthMet Foshan confirmed pickup of all goods. Delivery of 1,014.88 MT of aluminum ingot is complete.

macro_risk_events.description: Social inventories of aluminum ingot in Foshan stand at about 180,000 MT, a moderately low level for the year. Primary aluminum smelters in Yunnan are restarting slowly during the wet season, and the South China spot premium remains at 60-90 CNY/MT. Large orders trade at slightly higher prices than small retail buyers pay.

Aluminum ingot storage in the Foshan area has a history of duplicate-pledge incidents (the 2022 aluminum ingot warehouse receipt scandal), so banks have tightened their review of aluminum ingot receipt pledges and require a designated delivery warehouse plus third-party supervision.

The buyer, SouthMet Foshan, is a subsidiary of a central state-owned enterprise (SouthMet Group) with an AAA credit rating; the seller, the Jinyuan group, is a large private aluminum group with a good credit record in recent years. Both are leading companies in the industry.
